context.body: Promise, order, and the approach to the land · Numbers 12:14–16
context.label: Canonical location

observations.body: Miriam remains outside the camp seven days, and the people do not travel until she returns.
observations.label: The camp waits for Miriam before moving to Paran: action

observations.body: Afterward the camp moves from Hazeroth and settles in the wilderness of Paran.
observations.label: The camp waits for Miriam before moving to Paran: response

payload.posture: Read Numbers 12:14–16 as promise, order, and the approach to the land evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage supplies sequence and location without yet explaining why leaders will be sent from Paran.
payload.title: The camp waits for Miriam before moving to Paran
